description:
## Goal

Update the GitHub Actions coverage upload step to a supported official release without changing artifact name, path, retention or failure behavior.

This is independent CI maintenance, not the recalculator epic's final barrier. It has no compiler-ticket prerequisites and is no longer a child of fz-tfn.

## Acceptance

Workflow syntax is valid; lint, audit, the full llvm-cov test step and artifact upload pass; the run has no controlled Node-runtime deprecation warning. Do not suppress the warning or remove the coverage artifact.
title: Remove the CI upload-artifact Node 20 deprecation
